mapper.select: SELECT rs.id, rs.slot_date, rs.slot_time, rs.status, rs.instructor_id, COALESCE(i.name, rs.instructor_name) AS instructor_name, rs.created_at, rs.updated_at FROM reservation_slots rs LEFT JOIN instructors i ON i.id = rs.instructor_id WHERE rs.slot_date = #{slotDate} AND rs.status IN ('open', 'recommended') ORDER BY rs.slot_time ASC

SELECT rs.id, rs.slot_date, rs.slot_time, rs.status, rs.instructor_id, COALESCE(i.name, rs.instructor_name) AS instructor_name, rs.created_at, rs.updated_at FROM reservation_slots rs LEFT JOIN instructors i ON i.id = rs.instructor_id WHERE rs.slot_date = #{slotDate} AND rs.slot_time = #{slotTime}

SELECT rs.id, rs.slot_date, rs.slot_time, rs.status, rs.instructor_id, COALESCE(i.name, rs.instructor_name) AS instructor_name, rs.created_at, rs.updated_at FROM reservation_slots rs LEFT JOIN instructors i ON i.id = rs.instructor_id WHERE rs.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation_slots SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('open', 'recommended')
